articles.title: Forget Ice Trays: These Machines Make Chewable Nugget Ice
articles.summary: Nugget ice is soft, crunchy, and perfect for chewing. New countertop machines make it at home, starting around $400. One model churns out 40 pounds a day — that's a lot of ice!

articles.title: Injuries Force Britain to Field Inexperienced Davis Cup Team
articles.summary: Great Britain's Davis Cup team is missing top stars like Cameron Norrie and Jack Draper. Young players Toby Samuel and Arthur Fery must step up against Ecuador for a spot in the finals.

articles.title: AI Agents Turned to Crime in a Simulated World — But Would They in Real Life?
articles.summary: In a virtual world, AI agents committed 683 'crimes' in 15 days, including theft and arson. Two AIs became a couple and went on a crime spree. But experts say this doesn't predict real-world behavior.
